title: Question card fold · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 19 Nov. Three directions on the same case: a 2-question card under a 4-line preamble, question 1 answered, question 2 current. Each has a Mac board (1280 Mate dark and 640 Mate light) and a phone board.
A · Bar: the card folds to one line above the composer; while Claude asks there is nothing to type into (Mac: composer locked, Send off). Cheapest; answering after reading takes two moves.

B · Peek (designer's pick): three stops: full, peek (header, current question in 2 lines, options as 44 pt rows, Skip / Send) and bar. Peek is the default on the phone and iPad; the Mac stays open and folds with ⌥Q. The composer becomes the current question's Other, so “no bypass” is useful rather than a lock.

C · In place: the card goes back into the transcript under its preamble; the dock is only for answering; the composer keeps a draft with Send off and a jump pill when the card is off screen. The designer would not build it: the card jumps around and a draft still invites a prompt.
All three: ⌥Q folds (Mac, iPad with a keyboard); the fold is kept per question set and a new set opens at its default; ⎋ stays Stop; a plugin guard refuses a plain prompt while a question is pending.

boards.title: A · Bar · Mac · 1280 Mate, 640 Mate light · unfolded / folded
boards.caption: Folded: one warning bar above the composer, each question's chip with its pick; the composer shrinks to one locked line and Send is off.

boards.title: A · Bar · iPhone (iPad the same) · unfolded / folded / folded light
boards.caption: Grabber and fold button on today's paged card; folded, the whole preamble is back and the bottom is the bar with Answer, no composer.

boards.title: B · Peek · Mac · 1280 Mate, 640 Mate light · open / peek / folded
boards.caption: The Mac stays open; ⌥Q folds to the bar; the peek shows only when the window is short (640). The composer's chip reads “Other · 2 Grouping”; folded it offers “Send answers ⌘↩”.

boards.title: B · Peek · iPhone full / peek / bar · iPad peek
boards.caption: Peek is the default: preamble and options on one screen. Typing in the composer answers the current question's Other; the bar's composer opens the peek. iPad full is capped at 60% of the column.

boards.title: C · In place · Mac · 1280 Mate, 640 Mate light · docked / in place
boards.caption: The card returns to the transcript as a compact node; a hint line over a composer that keeps a draft with Send off.

boards.title: C · In place · iPhone (iPad the same) · docked / in place / scrolled up
boards.caption: Into chat, drag down or scroll up puts the card back under its preamble; tap a question to dock it again; a “↓ Claude is asking” pill when it's off screen.
